case_name: Arjun Singh v. The State of Maharashtra
facts: This appeal arises out of a conviction under Penal Code Section 302 for the offense of Murder.
The appellant challenges the judgment of the High Court on grounds of systemic failure.
petitioner_arguments: We have heard the explicit points argued by the petitioner
court_reasoning: After careful consideration of the facts, the appeal is hereby allowed and the conviction is set aside.
holding: The appeal is hereby allowed and the conviction is set aside.
